newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: London Secs in A$200 mln water deal.
newsitem.headline: London Secs in A$200 mln water deal.

text.p: Infrastructure developer London Securities Ltd said it had signed a joint venture agreement to proceed with the next stage of a A$200 million project to supply water to the Philippine city of Cebu.

It said Australian Trade Minister Tim Fischer and Philippines' Secretary Of Trade and Industry Cesar Bautista witnessed the signing of a memorandum of understanding for the Cebu City Water Project to proceed to its next stage.
"The A$200 million project is a joint venture between Australian listed company, London Securities and its Asian partners," London said.
The project will develop a pipeline and water treatment plant to supply fresh water on the island of Cebu, it said.
London Securities plans to change its name to Asia Pacific Infrastructure Ltd pending shareholder approval in December.
A spokeswoman for London said London's joint venture partners and their stakes had not been identified yet.
London's shares were down 0.5 of a cent at 41.5 cents at 1.50 p.m. (0250 GMT).
